comments.body:
Thanks again, this one is clean too. The types have accepted a single string since v14, but at runtime only an array counted, so a string fell back to scanning the locale folder (or threw with a function `localePath`). Normalizing it up front fixes every path at once, and the tests cover both `localePath` kinds.

Since it changes what a page gets when it passes a string, I noted that in the changelog.

thx, included in v16.4.10
